title: Director, Information Technology
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Director, Information Technology**
**Location:**
Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India
  
  
**Position Summary**
The
**Director, Information Technology**
will provide strategic and operational leadership for ADI's IT organization in India, driving technology strategy, business partnership, delivery excellence, and organizational development. The role will lead a portfolio of enterprise applications with a primary focus on supporting ADI's global Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations functions.
  
  
Working closely with business leaders, executive stakeholders, and global IT teams, the Director will lead strategic initiatives, application modernization, operational improvements, and AI-enabled digital transformation efforts that support business growth and operational excellence.
  
  
The Director will report to the Sr. Director, IT (India) and work closely with global IT and business leadership teams.
  
  
**Leadership Profile**
The successful candidate will be a people-first leader with exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills. They will have a proven track record of building and developing high-performing teams across multiple locations, cultures, and time zones while effectively navigating both solid-line and matrixed reporting structures.
  
  
Through strong collaboration, influence, and relationship-building capabilities, this leader will foster alignment across business and IT organizations, drive accountability, and deliver results in a complex global environment.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader with strong business acumen, capable of delivering results through influence, developing future leaders, and fostering strong partnerships across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, and IT.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership & Business Partnership**

* Partner with business and IT leaders to define and execute technology strategies supporting business priorities and enterprise IT initiatives.
* Drive portfolio planning, prioritization, governance, and execution of strategic programs.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders and identify opportunities for innovation, AI, automation, advanced analytics, and operational improvement.
* Align technology investments with business objectives and measurable outcomes.
* Help shape and execute digital transformation initiatives that improve productivity, decision-making, and operational efficiency.

**Technology & Applications Leadership**

* Lead delivery, support, enhancement, integration, and modernization of enterprise applications.
* Provide leadership for business-critical systems supporting Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning, and Operations, including SAP, Blue Yonder/JDA, and related platforms.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
* Ensure application reliability, scalability, security, and alignment with evolving business needs.

**Organization & Talent Development**

* Lead and develop a high-performing organization of 50+ IT professionals across multiple locations.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, coach, mentor, and retain top talent while building a strong leadership pipeline and succession plans.
* Successfully lead through both direct and matrixed organizational structures, driving results through influence and collaboration.

**Operational Excellence & Governance**

* Establish performance metrics, operational dashboards, and governance mechanisms to drive delivery excellence.
* Champion continuous improvement through disciplined program, project, and portfolio management practices.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, cybersecurity requirements, privacy policies, and risk management processes.
* Manage strategic vendor relationships, budgets, and stakeholder expectations.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive IT leadership experience.
* Significant experience supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain organizations within the semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, or related industries.
* Preferred experience with enterprise applications such as SAP, Blue Yonder/JDA, and related business systems.
* Proven success leading business transformation, application modernization, and enterprise technology initiatives.
* Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, automation, and advanced analytics to deliver measurable business value and operational improvements.

**Leadership & Professional Skills**

* Exceptional leadership, communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrated success leading geographically distributed teams through direct leadership, matrix management, and stakeholder influence.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders and build alignment across diverse organizations.
* Proven ability to develop talent, build organizational capability, and foster high-performance teams.
* Strategic thinker with a strong execution mindset and passion for continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of how emerging technologies, including AI and automation, can be applied to solve business challenges and improve operational effectiveness.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*
*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*
Job Req Type: Experienced
  
  
Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time
  
  
Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

title: NPD Manager
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced
**NPD Manager**
to drive innovation and product development in the food and nutrition segment. The role involves managing the end-to-end New Product Development (NPD) lifecycle, from concept development and formulation to commercialization and product launch, with a focus on nutrition, taste, quality, food safety, and market demand.

The candidate will lead the development of products such as
**protein bars, protein powders, nutritional spreads, breakfast cereals, and other innovative food and nutrition products**
, ensuring regulatory compliance and commercial viability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and launch innovative food and nutrition products, including
  **protein bars, protein powders, nutritional spreads, breakfast cereals, and other functional food products**
  .
* Manage the complete NPD lifecycle, from ideation and formulation to trials, scale-up, commercialization, and market launch.
* Ensure products meet nutritional requirements, taste expectations, quality standards, and consumer preferences.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations, food safety standards, and product labelling requirements.
* Identify and evaluate new ingredients, functional ingredients, suppliers, and packaging materials.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, consumer trials, and sensory evaluations to improve product formulations.
* Collaborate with R&D, production, quality assurance, procurement, and marketing teams to ensure successful product launches.
* Optimize product formulations and manufacturing costs while maintaining product quality and nutritional value.
* Oversee product trials, shelf-life studies, stability testing, and manufacturing scale-up.
* Monitor project timelines, budgets, product performance, and commercialization milestones.
* Keep up to date with emerging trends in kids’ nutrition, functional foods, protein-based products, and health-focused FMCG categories.

title: Founders Office
description:
About SurelyPlaced

SurelyPlaced helps international candidates in the US (OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, H-1B and H-4 EAD) land the jobs they're qualified for. We run their entire job search end to end: ATS-optimized resumes, high-volume targeted applications, and interview preparation. We're growing fast and expanding into new global markets.

About the Role

The Founder's Office is where our most important problems land first. You'll work directly with the founders on strategy, special projects and execution across sales, marketing, operations and new markets. This role is for someone who wants founder-level exposure early in their career, and who would rather own outcomes than tasks.

Compensation

• ₹9 LPA fixed (₹75,000/month)

• Up to ₹3 LPA performance-based variable (up to ₹25,000/month)

• Total CTC: up to ₹12 LPA

Work Setup

• Full-time, hybrid

• Office: Vaishnodevi Circle, Gandhinagar

What You'll Do

• Drive high-priority projects for the founders from idea to execution

• Support new market launches with research, planning and coordination

• Build and track business dashboards and MIS across sales, marketing and operations

• Find bottlenecks in our processes and fix them, with documentation and SOPs

• Coordinate across sales, marketing, delivery and hiring teams to keep priorities moving

• Prepare decks, briefs and analyses that help the founders make decisions faster

• Use AI tools and automation to make the team faster and more efficient

• Step in wherever the business needs you most that week

What We're Looking For

• 1–4 years of experience in a startup, consulting, strategy, operations or a founder's office role (exceptional freshers welcome)

• High ownership: you treat problems like they're your own

• Structured thinker who brings clarity to ambiguous, fast-moving situations

• Strong written and verbal communication in English

• Comfortable with data: strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, able to turn numbers into decisions

• Bias for action: you ship, learn and iterate quickly

• Trustworthy with confidential, founder-level information

Good to Have

• MBA or a degree from a strong business, engineering or economics program

• Experience in EdTech, staffing, career services or a high-growth startup

• Hands-on with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation platforms such as n8n/Zapier)

• Exposure to sales operations, growth marketing or international markets

Why Join Us

• Work directly with the founders and see how a company is built from the inside

• Ownership of real projects from week one

• Fast-track growth into leadership roles as the company scales

• Hybrid flexibility with a collaborative office in Gandhinagar

How to Apply

Apply directly through LinkedIn, or email your resume to hr@surelyplaced.com with the subject line "Founder's Office – [Your Name]". Bonus: include 3–4 lines on a project you fully owned and what it achieved.

**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager- Product Innovation & Fabric Expert**
**Location: Gandhinagar**
**About The Role**
To lead product innovation and fabric development initiatives for the Covers category by improving product aesthetics, functionality, durability, and customer experience through advanced fabric research, innovative stitching techniques, accessories development, and product engineering. The role will be responsible for repositioning the entire Covers portfolio by identifying best-in-class fabrics, optimizing product construction, and introducing innovative design features that enhance perceived value while maintaining cost competitiveness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Design & Aesthetic Enhancement
* Review existing Covers portfolio and benchmark against global competitors.
* Develop innovative stitching patterns and construction methods to improve product appearance.
* Improve product fit, shape retention, and premium look.
* Introduce design elements that enhance customer perception and usability.
* Standardize product finishing specifications across categories.
* Improve packaging and presentation of finished products.
* Accessories & Trim Innovation
* Develop and evaluate accessories such as:
* Buckles
* Straps
* Drawcords
* Elastic systems
* Velcro closures
* Air vents
* Handles
* Reinforcement patches
* Branding elements
* Identify opportunities to improve functionality and aesthetics through trims and hardware.
* Fabric Research & Development
* Lead fabric innovation programs for all cover categories.
* Evaluate lighter-weight fabrics without compromising durability.
* Develop category-wise fabric strategy based on:
* Weather resistance
* UV resistance
* Water repellency
* Breathability
* Strength
* Cost
* Customer expectations
* Benchmark global fabric suppliers and technologies.
* Develop alternative fabric sourcing strategies to reduce cost and improve performance.
* Work with suppliers on new coating and finishing technologies.
* Product Engineering & Testing
* Define performance standards for each category.
* Conduct testing for:
* UV resistance
* Waterproofness
* Tear strength
* Abrasion resistance
* Color fastness
* Weathering performance
* Establish product validation protocols before commercialization.
* Create technical specifications and BOM standards.
* Competitive Benchmarking
* Benchmark leading brands in:
* Outdoor covers
* Furniture covers
* Grill covers
* Equipment covers
* Automotive covers
* Identify innovation trends and customer pain points.
* Recommend product upgrades based on market intelligence.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with:
* Design Team
* Sourcing Team
* Manufacturing Team
* Quality Team
* Product Management Team
* Support pilot runs and commercialization of new products.
* Drive innovation projects from concept to production launch.

**Key Deliverables (First 12 Months)**
**Product Enhancement**

* Complete review of entire Covers portfolio.
* Develop category-wise premium product positioning strategy.
* Launch improved construction standards for all key categories.

**Fabric Development**
Identify and validate lighter-weight fabric alternatives.
  
  
Develop fabric matrix for each cover category.
  
  
Deliver minimum 3–5 new fabric innovations.
  
  
**Innovation Pipeline**
Launch minimum 10 product improvement initiatives.
  
  
Reduce product weight while maintaining performance standards.
  
  
Improve customer satisfaction related to fit, appearance, and functionality.
  
  
**Cost & Value Improvement**
Improve value perception without increasing product cost significantly.
  
  
Develop premium and value-engineered product tiers.
  
  
**Key Requirements**
**Education**

* B.Tech / B.E. Textile Technology
* Technical Textiles
* Apparel Technology
* Product Engineering

**Experience**

* 10–15+ years experience in:
* Technical textiles
* Outdoor products
* Protective covers
* Furniture covers
* Automotive covers
* Home furnishing products
* Product development

**Technical Skills**

* Fabric development and sourcing
* Sewing engineering
* Pattern development
* Technical textiles
* Product testing
* Product innovation
* Vendor development
* Cost engineering

**Desired Industry Background**
**Preferred From**

* Outdoor furniture cover manufacturers
* Automotive cover manufacturers
* Technical textile companies
* Home furnishing manufacturers
* Global brands specializing in outdoor protection products
